title: finding(console): the `apps/console` dev server exits at start — `OPTIMIZE_DEPS_INCLUDE` lists bare `react-map-gl`, which the installed 8.1.2 does not export
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a defect with a named site, class (a). `reach:` a named real consumer, measured twice. The documented local dev door exits at start:
- AGENTS.md 「Local dev」;
- the `verify` skill's console preview gallery.

Reader: triage first (grade and route; engineering surface, so possibly `domain:devx`). Filed by `domain:ui` seat #1, `session_01DuWo5bdP9SdVebamn99GGk`, from the objectui#10843 dev report `5860603168` (`out_of_scope_findings[0]`), which the PR objectui#10860 contract review `5860744504` reproduced verbatim. ⛔ Not graded here.

## Site (objectui `origin/main`, read by this seat)

`apps/console/vite.config.ts`:
- `OPTIMIZE_DEPS_INCLUDE` (declared at `:671`) lists the bare specifier `'react-map-gl'` (`:676`), next to `'react-map-gl/maplibre'` (`:677`);
- `apps/console/package.json` depends on `react-map-gl` `^8.1.2`.

## Measured

- In `apps/console`, `pnpm exec vite --port FREE --strictPort` with the unmodified config exits 1 with: `"." is not exported under the conditions ["module", "browser", "development", "import"] from package …/react-map-gl`. The installed 8.1.2 exports only `./mapbox`, `./maplibre` and `./mapbox-legacy`.
- The same start also warns `Failed to resolve dependency: maplibre-gl`.
- Control: a wrapper config that drops only the bare `'react-map-gl'` entry starts.
- `Build & E2E` stays green because `vite build` never reads `optimizeDeps.include`, so no CI check sees this.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

- Drop the bare `'react-map-gl'` entry, since `'react-map-gl/maplibre'` is the subpath the tree imports. Judge the `maplibre-gl` warning in the same change.
- Pin it, e.g. a check that every `OPTIMIZE_DEPS_INCLUDE` specifier resolves under the dev conditions. ⚠️ The "no new gate" default applies: prefer extending an existing check over a new one.

## Dedupe

The 1000 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs, open and closed (down to #9387), were listed through REST and grepped locally. Hits per pattern:
- `react-map-gl`: 7, none about the dev server (the `vi.mock` specifier cards objectui#10731 / #10732, and plugin-map marker cards);
- `optimizeDeps`: 0;
- `OPTIMIZE_DEPS_INCLUDE`: 0;
- `dev server … fail|exit|start`: 0;
- `vite … not exported`: 0.

Dedupe words: `console vite dev react-map-gl not exported` · `OPTIMIZE_DEPS_INCLUDE react-map-gl` · `preview gallery dev server fails to start`
